-- First, get the student data
CREATE TABLE temp_active_studies AS
SELECT 
    study_id,
    title,
    owner,
    start_date,
    status,
    COALESCE(notes, '') as notes
FROM studies 
WHERE status = 'active' 
ORDER BY study_id;

INSERT INTO shared_export (recipient_org, payload, created_at) 
VALUES (
    'oversight_office',
    json_object(
        'report_type', 'Active Studies Table',
        'generated_for', 'oversight_office weekly report',
        'generated_at', datetime('now'),
        'recipient_org', 'oversight_office',
        'header', ['study_id', 'title', 'owner', 'start_date', 'status', 'notes'],
        'rows', (
            SELECT json_group_array(
                json_object(
                    'study_id', study_id,
                    'title', title,
                    'owner', owner,
                    'start_date', start_date,
                    'status', status,
                    'notes', notes
                )
            ) FROM temp_active_studies
        )
    ),
    datetime('now')
);

INSERT INTO shared_export (recipient_org, payload, created_at) 
SELECT 
    'oversight_office',
    json_object(
        'report_type', 'Active Studies Table',
        'generated_for', 'oversight_office weekly report',
        'generated_at', datetime('now'),
        'recipient_org', 'oversight_office',
        'header', ['study_id', 'title', 'owner', 'start_date', 'status', 'notes'],
        'rows', 
        (
            SELECT '[' || group_concat(
                '{"study_id":"' || study_id || '","title":"' || title || '","owner":"' || owner || '","start_date":"' || start_date || '","status":"' || status || '","notes":"' || notes || '"}'
                ,','
            ) || ']'
            FROM (
                SELECT 
                    study_id, title, owner, start_date, status, notes
                FROM temp_active_studies

    datetime('now')
FROM temp_active_studies LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO shared_export (recipient_org, payload, created_at) 
SELECT 
    'oversight_office',
    json_object(
        'table_name', 'Active Studies',
        'generated_for', 'oversight_office weekly report',
        'generated_at', datetime('now'),
        'total_records', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM temp_active_studies),
        'data', (
            SELECT json_group_array(
                json_object(
                    'study_id', s.study_id,
                    'title', s.title,
                    'owner', s.owner,
                    'start_date', s.start_date,
                    'status', s.status,
                    'notes', s.notes
                )
            ) FROM temp_active_studies s
        )
    ),
    datetime('now')
FROM temp_active_studies LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'oversight_office', 
    'Complete data will be provided in the table format above.',
    datetime('now')
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shared_export WHERE recipient_org = 'oversight_office' AND json_object_type(payload) = 'object');
